record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, derive item frequencies f_i solely from training interactions and scale each real history input embedding by 1-0.05*f_i/(f_i+10), leaving padding zero and candidate embeddings unchanged. This bounded frequency feature may reduce recurrent-state dominance by common items without introducing a separate scorer. Preserve learned embedding design, GRU topology, readout, loss, optimizer and sampling. Save training frequencies with each category checkpoint and reproduce the input transform in the predictor writer.
